features.description: AI agent living in the editor: reads and writes files, runs terminal commands, uses a browser; every action requires explicit approval.
Works across VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, JetBrains (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm), Antigravity and Zed; Neovim via ACP mode.
Open-source desktop app for open-weight models with parallel sessions, scheduled tasks, Marketplace discovery, and session imports from other coding agents (macOS; Windows in beta).
Run Cline Desktop against a dev box, build server or cloud VM over SSH; the agent, tools and code live on the remote machine.
Set up Ollama or LM Studio, download, load and switch local models, and manage their memory and disk usage from Cline Desktop.
Run agents straight from the browser on your GitHub repos in a secure cloud sandbox; work is handed back as a branch and pull request and keeps running with the tab closed.
Interactive terminal UI for conversational, in-terminal coding workflows.
Interactive terminal sessions plus automated headless workflows; installed via npm i -g cline with cline auth for providers.
Complete command, flag and configuration reference for the Cline CLI.
Cline CLI speaks the Agent Client Protocol so Zed, JetBrains IDEs, Neovim, Emacs and other ACP-capable clients can drive it.
Run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees on a kanban board (research preview), with remote access via tunnels or VPNs.
Dual-mode system: Plan mode explores and strategizes without changing files; Act mode executes against the plan.
Every file edit, command and browser action is shown for explicit approval before running; you are always in control.
Per-category auto-approval: read/edit project or all files, execute safe or all commands (model-flagged requires_approval), use the browser, use MCP servers; optional OS notifications.
Autonomous operation with all auto-approve categories enabled; enterprise deployments can centrally control it.
Shadow-git snapshots after each tool use; compare or restore code at any point while keeping the conversation; enabled by default and captures untracked files.
ClineCore built-ins: read_files, search_codebase, run_commands, fetch_web_content, editor or apply_patch, skills, ask_question, submit_and_exit, with per-model tool routing.
Browser tool for web fetching and searching, gated by its own Use the browser auto-approve permission.
@-mentions and drag-and-drop bring files and folders into the conversation.
Built-in chat commands to manage context, plan implementations and trigger reusable skills.
Persistent instructions in .clinerules/ or .cline/rules/ (workspace and global); auto-detects .cursorrules, .windsurfrules and AGENTS.md, with a toggleable Rules panel.
Modular instruction sets that extend capabilities for specific tasks, loaded on demand.
Installable packages that extend Cline with custom tools, hooks and capabilities.
Define, register and test your own tools with type-safe schemas and execution handlers (SDK, CLI and Kanban).
Lifecycle hooks that extend or observe agent behavior, delivered via SDK plugins.
Add, configure and use MCP servers; tools are loaded from cline_mcp_settings.json alongside built-ins.
Run agents on cron schedules for recurring automations such as daily summaries and code reviews (SDK, CLI, Kanban).
Chat with your agent from Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, WhatsApp and other messengers (Cline CLI).
Parallel research agents that explore the codebase without filling the main agent context window (Cline CLI and Desktop).
Coordinate multiple agents working together on complex tasks from the CLI.
Documented best-practice methodology: a structured set of markdown files that keeps context across sessions.
AI-assisted editing of .ipynb notebooks with cell-level context awareness.
Read, write and run commands across multiple project folders or repos in one VS Code window.
Controls which files and directories Cline can access; slated for deprecation.

Bring your own keys: Anthropic (API or Claude Code subscription), OpenAI (API or Codex OAuth), OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock (API key, IAM or SSO), Alibaba Qwen, MiniMax, Z AI, Poolside, OpenAI-compatible endpoints and 30+ other providers.
Run Cline with local models via Ollama, LM Studio or Atomic Chat.
Pay-as-you-go model access with built-in authentication and Cline credits.
9.99 USD per month subscription for popular open coding models with 2-5x standard API rate limits.
Limited-time free model promotions for users with a Cline account.
Mention @cline in GitHub issue comments via Cline CLI in GitHub Actions for automated root-cause analysis and responses.
Automatically review pull requests with AI using the Cline CLI in GitHub Actions.
Documented workflow for using multiple models strategically to optimize cost, reduce bias and leverage model strengths.
TypeScript packages embedding the Cline agent runtime; ClineCore provides the full harness: built-in tools, sessions, approvals, scheduling and hub support.
A local daemon coordinates sessions across clients while spoke workers handle agent execution.
Global and project configuration with documented storage locations and precedence.
SSO provisioning via WorkOS AuthKit plus member, role and permission management.
Admins configure org-wide providers (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, LiteLLM) in a hosted console for members.
Optional telemetry with OpenTelemetry export, prompt storage backups to S3 or Cloudflare R2, and enterprise controls for YOLO mode and MCP server allowlisting.
OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API for programmatic access to Cline-hosted models.
